Every setting on this page is at its default.
The modes on the strip (chat, research, plan, code, free) and the flows that
chain them, with what each mode allows held by code.
on (default). The strip shows the mode and the way of working, and code holds
Claude to them: in plan mode, for one, it writes only the plan.
off: No modes, ways of working or flows: Claude works as in plain Claude Code,
Block: the call does not run, and Claude is
told not to work around it.
